+import pytest
+import jmespath
+from jmespath import exceptions
+from jmespath import functions
+
+
+def test_jmespath_truthiness_for_predicates():
+    values = [None, False, 0, "", [], {}, 1, "x", [0], {"x": 0}]
+    assert jmespath.search("filter_by(@, &@)", values) == [0, 1, "x", [0], {"x": 0}]
+    assert jmespath.search("any_by(@, &@)", [0]) is True
+    assert jmespath.search("all_by(@, &@)", [0, 1]) is True
+    assert jmespath.search("any_by(@, &@)", [None, False, "", [], {}]) is False
+    assert jmespath.search("all_by(@, &@)", [0, False]) is False
+
+
+def test_empty_and_null_retention():
+    for expression, expected in [("filter_by(@, &unknown())", []), ("any_by(@, &unknown())", False), ("all_by(@, &unknown())", True)]:
+        assert jmespath.search(expression, []) == expected
+    data = [None, {"a": 1}]
+    result = jmespath.search("filter_by(@, &`true`)", data)
+    assert result == data
+    assert result is not data
+    assert result[1] is data[1]
+
+
+class Recorder(functions.Functions):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.seen = []
+
+    @functions.signature({"types": []})
+    def _func_probe(self, arg):
+        self.seen.append(arg)
+        return arg
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("expression, expected, seen", [
+    ("any_by(@, &probe(@))", True, [0]),
+    ("all_by(@, &probe(@))", False, [0, False]),
+    ("filter_by(@, &probe(@))", [0, "x"], [0, False, "x"]),
+])
+def test_short_circuit_and_custom_dispatch(expression, expected, seen):
+    recorder = Recorder()
+    options = jmespath.Options(custom_functions=recorder)
+    assert jmespath.compile(expression).search([0, False, "x"], options=options) == expected
+    assert recorder.seen == seen
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["filter_by", "any_by", "all_by"])
+def test_signatures(name):
+    with pytest.raises(exceptions.ArityError):
+        jmespath.search(name + "(@)", [])
+    with pytest.raises(exceptions.JMESPathTypeError):
+        jmespath.search(name + "(@, &@)", {})
+    with pytest.raises(exceptions.JMESPathTypeError):
+        jmespath.search(name + "(@, @)", [])

spec.question:
Add three registered built-ins with signatures `filter_by(array, expref)`, `any_by(array, expref)`, and `all_by(array, expref)`. Each predicate expression reference is evaluated against individual array elements using the current interpreter and options, and its result is interpreted with the same JMESPath truth rules as a filter predicate, including numeric zero being true.

`filter_by` must return a new list of the original elements whose predicates are true, in input order; it must not discard a selected null element or copy selected objects. `any_by` must return a boolean and stop at the first true predicate. `all_by` must return a boolean and stop at the first false predicate. On an empty array their results must respectively be `[]`, `false`, and `true`, without evaluating the expression reference. Errors from predicates that are actually evaluated must propagate, while unevaluated predicates must have no effects. Use the existing arity and argument-type exception conventions, and make the functions available with both default and subclassed custom function providers. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
